records.source: Heavy and solid, this brown orb feels like a rock that has been worn smooth by a constant flow of water. On one side, there's an indentation that just fits a human hand. When activated, the bounder absorbs the user and teleports them to a nearby location within line of sight.

But despite his hard words, his eyes settle on yours. Studying. Deciding. His mouth settles into an irritated line.  

"Look," he says, running a hand over his stubbled scalp. "You hide it well, but I can tell you're new here. I ent trying to offend you, but I... don't like leaving folk new to Sagus on their own. If you have questions about the city - or Circus Minor in particular - I'll answer 'em, free of charge."

He stares at her, chewing his lip, clearly trying to work up the courage to talk to her... to convince her of something. Finally, with a wry twist of his mouth, he turns back at you.

entry_reviews.reason: 经 Descriptor 定义确认为游戏术语，修正字面误译并限定适用范围。

source.evidence: record 1 为 “Hardened”，record 6 原文 “A set of bonuses granted by the Hardened descriptor.” 证实其为 Descriptor 名称，而非普通形容词用法。

translation.evidence: 原译“硬化”取自物理/病理义；record 6、7 表明该词是角色背景特质（Descriptor），授予属性与技能调整，改译为人物特质名“坚毅”，并因官方译名未确认按 reference 暂定。

category.evidence: 维持“其他”：Descriptor 为角色特质模板，不属物品/地名/技能/组织/种族/身份等类，分类合法。

consistency.evidence: 本批无其他 Hardened 变体或同源条目，term_families.candidates 为空；通过 text + case_sensitive 的 applicability 与普通词 hardened 区分，不影响其他语境。

patch.term_reason: record 6 “A set of bonuses granted by the Hardened descriptor.” 与 record 7 说明 Descriptor 是角色创建时选定的背景特质并调整初始属性/技能；此处 Hardened 修饰人物而非材料，属人物特质名，不取“硬化”的物理/病理义，暂译“坚毅”；官方译名未确认，按 reference 处理。

applicability.reason: record 1 为独立词条 “Hardened”，record 6 为 “the Hardened descriptor”，两处均指 Descriptor 名称且首字母大写，可与普通词 hardened（如材料“硬化”）区分。

edits.reason: 修正 Descriptor 名称的字面误译并补齐术语属性与适用范围，避免“硬化”被套用到人物特质语境。
